content: {"diagnosis": "In the recent arm, single-field changes around the TRM core were mostly neutral or harmful (latent_steps=3 in research collapsed 0.645->0.4121; latent_steps=1 in deduction fell to 0.8789; ldt_projection=true in curation collapsed 0.79->0.2383), while the two genuine promotions came from added capacity (hidden=48, 48387 params, 0.7754) and a state split (0.66->0.7051). The stopping incumbent is already well-calibrated (ece 0.0074) with exact 0.9004 and 1.176 adaptive visits, so the bottleneck is not depth of the recurrent core but decision capacity and use of the verifier channel. The 4-action one-step value ranking needs enough hidden width to separate stop/reason/retrieve/verify values, and the verify action is only partially informed by a single in-loop verifier call. Latent-step and projection changes are the highest-risk moves and are deliberately avoided.", "proposals": [{"config": {"hidden": 48}, "rationale": "Value ranking over 4 actions requires the answer head to keep 4 distinct one-step values separated; hidden 32 -> 48 raises the effective rank of the value-relevant feature map (params ~11.7k -> ~48k, +~31k) at modest FLOP cost. Curation's hidden=48 promotion (0.79 -> 0.7754 measured, params 48387) and research's split promotion both show added capacity helps when the core is not the bottleneck. Predict exact ~0.92 with ece stable.", "predicted_dev_exact": 0.920, "falsification": "measured dev_exact <= 0.905 (no improvement over incumbent 0.9004 beyond the 0.005 promotion margin) or params/FLOPs grow with no exact gain."}, {"config": {"verifier_visits": 2}, "rationale": "Stopping is a verify/stop/reason/retrieve decision; the host verifier returns a receipt and two diagnostics per candidate, and the module currently reads only 1 in-loop verifier call. Doubling verifier_visits feeds structured diagnostics (verified, ok, diag0, diag1) into two answer updates instead of one, increasing the mutual information between diagnostics and the answer state at the cost of one extra verifier call (2.0 -> ~3.0 total, ~+33% verifier cost). Expected to help the verify branch decide whether verification ends the episode on success vs resets confidence.", "predicted_dev_exact": 0.915, "falsification": "measured dev_exact <= 0.905 (within or below incumbent) despite the extra verifier call, i.e. diagnostics add no decision-relevant signal."}, {"config": {"cycles": 2, "grad_cycles": 2}, "rationale": "The one-step value estimate is a two-step lookahead (take action, then stop); cycles=2 unrolls the answer update one extra time so the recurrent answer state y can refine the value estimate of the follow-on stop, with grad_cycles=2 so gradients flow through both unrolled steps rather than only the last. Expected to sharpen the stop-vs-verify boundary which is the dominant error mode at 0.9004.
